description_before: Partial metadata check allowed checkpoint reuse when only some params matched; subsequent code ran if not eval_weight_path.exists() without halting on mismatch.
remediation_after: Explicit 20-field run identity configuration built via build_fold_run_identity(); verify_fold_reuse_safety() checks all fields + actual checkpoint & prediction SHA256; strict safety guard halts execution with RuntimeError if checkpoint exists with mismatched metadata.

description_before: Computed fingerprints (script/yaml/manifest) were not included in skip decision; old best.pt could be accepted without verifying all params.
remediation_after: Built canonical build_experiment_run_identity() and verify_ablation_reuse_safety() validating script_sha256 data_yaml_sha256 manifest_sha256 pretrained_weights_sha256 epochs batch imgsz seed; strictly rejects mismatched weights.

description_before: Stage 7 had separate parsing and matching implementations with NameError bug on matched_preds; metrics taxonomy unaligned with Stage 8.
remediation_after: Unified completely with research_utils/detection_metrics.py using canonical parse_yolo_labels classify_object_size greedy_bipartite_matching and get_image_dimensions; fixed unassigned prediction counting.

description_before: Hardcoded 640x640 dimensions in parse_yolo_labels and target_small_box conversions produced incorrect object sizes and crop windows on non-640 images.
remediation_after: Replaced all static 640 calls with dynamic get_image_dimensions(); stored explicit box_format norm_xyxy img_width and img_height in manifest; apply_context_crop adheres to explicit unit contract.

description_before: Annotation verification only checked row counts and silently clamped out-of-range polygon coordinates to [0 1].
remediation_after: Removed silent clamping in convert_polygon_to_bbox (fails fast on out-of-bounds); added full image-label pair parity orphan detection size parity and geometric box equivalence (tol <= 1e-4).
proof_test: test_stage_9_5_regression.py (TestAnnotationStandardizationAndIntegrity: 10 tests); verify-only run on 12829 images

description_before: Lack of dataloader/transform integration proof that crop executes in Ultralytics data flow; weight sum tolerance too strict for historical manifests.
remediation_after: Added real Ultralytics Dataset/Collate integration test; supported lazy image loading in apply_context_crop; calibrated weight sum tolerance to 0.005 for corrupted sample skips.

description_before: Historical scratch artifacts contained paths pointing to cassava-v7-research; conflicting arguments passed to stage_8_1.
remediation_after: Enforced cassava-v7-standardized/data.yaml as default SSOT; added preflight split path integrity checks ensuring zero historical paths in clean dry-runs; verified zero cross-fold group leakage.
proof_test: dry_run_standardized_audit.json; safe dry-run execution on standardized dataset

description_before: Mathematical formula validation required strictly positive finite probabilities summing to 1.0 with robust fallback when sum(D) = 0.
remediation_after: Implemented strict mathematical validation (0 <= lambda <= 1; 0 <= D <= 1; P(k) > 0; sum(P) ~ 1.0) with analytical fallback to uniform 1/N when sum(D) = 0.

description_before: Test benchmark script risks accidental evaluation if invoked without confirmation guards.
remediation_after: Reinforced explicit environment confirmation guard (RUN_FINAL_TEST_BENCHMARK=1); locked benchmark remains unexecuted during Stage 9.5.
proof_test: Static code inspection and guard assertion
